newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Borg-Warner EPS seen higher.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Borg-Warner EPS seen higher.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial said Wednesday it raised its earnings per share estimate on Borg-Warner Automotive Inc to $0.99 from $0.89. It also increased the full-year projection to $4.44 from $4.32.
-- Mesirow said it received upward guidance from Borg-Warner management based on strong build rates overall and in particular in light trucks and engines using the company's engine timing systems.
-- It reiterated a focus buy rating and 12-month price target of $50.
